line: Crowley's Six of Wands is the card for the second decan of Leo, with Jupiter as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Leo.

quotes.quote: The Six of Wands is called Victory.
The reference is also to Jupiter and Leo

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: This card represents Tiphareth of the suit of Fire.
